items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: So there was a little band in the Palladium -- in the Savoy called the Hy Clark and his Missourians. They need a trumpet. And when I went there, they give me the job.

ctx.x: That's it. So I give this job to this kid who just came from Cuba, sacrifice, I give him the job and give my horn to him. So I say now, I definitely bet you I'm a trumpet player now.

So there was a little band in the Palladium -- in the Savoy called the Hy Clark and his Missourians. They need a trumpet. And when I went there, they give me the job. It was a second-rate orchestra. But that's when I really got developed.
Was this a kind of an opening band (inaudible)?
